title: Room 214 Rising
author: Sable Nakamura
blurb: Ines Ravensworth, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent twelve years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
